jobDescription:
Support Specialist
We are seeking a highly skilled and customer-focused Support Specialist (Tier I) to support the Customer Success organization. This role serves as the first point of contact for customer support requests and plays an important role in delivering a positive customer experience by resolving Tier I issues, triaging customer inquiries, and ensuring timely escalation of more complex requests. The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, and committed to delivering exceptional service while collaborating across teams to maintain the high standards of responsiveness, professionalism, and operational excellence that define InvoiceCloud's culture. This position supports customers using the InvoiceCloud platform by helping them navigate the Biller Portal, understand InvoiceCloud products and services, generate reports, and perform approved system changes. Responsibilities also include documenting customer interactions, maintaining accurate case information and contributing to efficient issue resolution.
Success Profile:
This role is anchored in our company's core competencies. These competencies reflect the mindsets and behaviors that define success in this role. Below is how each competency translates into meaningful impact and outcomes for this position.
Takes Ownership
Serve as the first point of contact for incoming customer calls, consistently answering support inquiries and delivering professional, timely assistance while maintaining established service expectations. Take ownership of incoming Tier I support tickets by accurately triaging requests, selecting appropriate case fields, documenting customer interactions, and ensuring issues are routed correctly when escalation is required. Develop expertise in InvoiceCloud products, services, internal systems, the Biller Portal, Customer Portal, CRM, and Helpdesk through structured training, certification, continuous learning, and application of product knowledge to customer interactions. Use approved AI-assisted tools to summarize customer interactions, draft support responses, and identify recommended next steps while validating all outputs for accuracy, privacy, and compliance before communicating with customers.
Customer-Centric
Deliver an exceptional customer experience by helping billers navigate the InvoiceCloud platform, generate reports, understand product functionality, and perform approved system changes that enable successful use of InvoiceCloud solutions. Demonstrate sound judgment when determining whether customer issues can be resolved within Tier I expectations or require escalation to Tier II, ensuring customers receive timely and appropriate support. Build trust through clear, professional verbal and written communication while maintaining a customer-focused approach during every interaction. Partner effectively with team members and managers to expedite ticket resolution, communicate emerging issues, and report widespread customer-impacting incidents promptly to minimize disruption. Participate in ongoing education, internal training, and continuous learning to improve product knowledge, enabling consistent, high-quality customer support and reinforcing customer confidence in InvoiceCloud solutions.
Results-Driven
Meet established service expectations by answering at least 90% of incoming customer calls, efficiently triaging Tier I support requests, and maintaining accurate documentation within the ticketing system. Progressively achieve operational performance milestones by resolving Tier I support tickets independently, documenting all customer interactions, and meeting monthly ticket resolution goals as proficiency develops. Complete required onboarding, internal certifications, product training, quizzes, and continuous education while applying newly acquired knowledge to improve customer outcomes and operational effectiveness. Monitor individual performance metrics, review weekly ticket statistics, and continuously improve productivity, quality, and consistency while maintaining attention to detail and adherence to established support processes.
Requirements:
  • Bachelors degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn and become proficient in InvoiceCloud products and services.
  • Strong customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality customer service.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and attention to detail.
  • Self-starter with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks and achieve results as part of a high-performing team.
  • Excellent organizational, planning, and time management skills.
  • Experience using Microsoft Office applications.
Preferred Requirements:
  • Experience using Salesforce.
  • Experience supporting payment processing within a SaaS environment.

Discipline: Executive Assistance CoE

Role Type: Assigned Support / Associate

Role Rank: Associate

The opportunity

We are looking for Executive Assistant who would be required to work in a team environment in delivering the secretarial needs of the global EY office senior management team such as diary management, calendar management, travel management, documentation, tool support and other administrative requirements that may arise on a need basis.

Your key responsibilities

  • The primary role and responsibility of this position will be to work in a team environment and deliver administrative services including, but not limited to
  • Diary Management - Provide support to the project team members on maintaining and managing key project meetings and the meeting location
  • Calendar Management - Maintaining project teams calendar to showcase all key events that needs to be planned.
  • Meetings Management - Working closely with the project teams and other stakeholders in scheduling/organizing the meeting or conference call
  • Travel Management - Support the project team members in booking the travel tickets
  • Workshop or Area visit Plan - Help in planning the agenda, for workshops/area visits by handling the logistics of stay, food and printing, etc.
  • Documentation - Recording the minutes of the meeting with clear emphasis on the key action points from the meeting. Maintaining the project database and ensure all documentations are captured and organized for ease of access.
  • Training Management - Provide support in setting up training by sending out invites, enabling cut-off point for training sessions, issuing confirmations and/or offering alternative dates. Supplement delegates with correct pre-work and sessions
  • Tool Support and administration – Administrative support on various internal/external tools used across EY offices
  • Data Processing and administration - Data capture, processing and administration of business information

Skills and attributes for success

  • The role requires someone who can manage several concurrent activities, with strong multi-tasking, prioritization, organizational and time management skills.
  • Administration and organization
    • Enjoys problem solving
    • Able to prioritize effectively
    • Strong project coordination skills
    • Comfortable using IT systems
  • Interpersonal skills
    • Excellent written and oral communication skills
    • A strong team player who is comfortable working collaboratively with others
    • Must be able to work virtually, and independently
    • Able to be diplomatic when dealing with clients
  • Flexibility
    • Respond well to deadlines and work outside of normal hours when required
    • Comfortable working on several activities concurrently
    • Able to work in a rapidly changing environment and prioritize accordingly
  • Key attributes
    • Professional and diplomatic communicator
    • Quality focused and takes pride in paying attention to detail
    • Self-starter, who can manage with minimal direction
    • Able to interact with senior management
    • Extremely organized and enjoys administration
    • Able to work in a team arrangement
    • Demonstrated experience in MS Office (Word, Excel & PowerPoint) and fair knowledge of MS Outlook

To qualify for the role, you must have

  • Any graduate or Postgraduate

Ideally, you’ll also have

  • 1 to 4 Years
  • At least a year of experience working in a team environment handling virtual secretarial services is preferred
  • Good command over English (written & spoken) is mandatory

What we offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

  • Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
  • Success, as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
  • Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
  • Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

jobDescription:
The Role

This is a full-cycle sales role. You will own everything from finding the right prospect to handing over a signed client - there is no SDR passing you leads, no pre-sales team doing the first call, and no account manager taking over after closure. You do it all, with demo support available when you need it.

You will be selling across three distinct product lines to three different buyer personas - HR leaders, finance and audit heads, and operations or project managers. The ability to switch context, speak the language of different decision-makers, and manage multiple pipelines simultaneously is central to this role.

What You Will Do

1. Database Generation & Prospecting

  • Build and maintain a structured prospect database across all three product lines and their respective buyer personas
  • Source contacts using LinkedIn, industry directories, CODISSIA / Chamber of Commerce member lists, trade publications, and local business networks
  • Segment database by product fit, company size, industry, and geography (CBE, Tirupur, Erode, and pan-Tamil Nadu as the business grows)
  • Maintain clean, updated records in CRM - every contact, every interaction, every follow-up logged

2. Cold Outreach & Lead Generation

  • Execute outbound outreach via phone calls, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, and email - targeting the right person with the right product message
  • Craft personalised outreach for each product and each buyer persona - the pitch to an HR Manager is fundamentally different from the pitch to a CFO
  • Handle gatekeepers, navigate to decision-makers, and earn the right to a conversation without being pushy
  • Consistently generate 40-60 qualified conversations per month across all product lines

3. Demo Scheduling & Coordination

  • Qualify prospects thoroughly before scheduling a demo - understand their pain, confirm decision-making authority, and set expectations
  • Coordinate with the internal demo support team to schedule and prepare tailored product demonstrations
  • Attend every demo as the relationship owner - your role during the demo is to read the room, handle objections in real time, and guide the conversation toward next steps
  • Brief the demo support team on the prospect's specific context and priorities before each session

4. Follow-Up,

  • Own the post-demo follow-up process - proposals, pricing discussions, handling objections, and pushing toward a decision
  • Navigate multi-stakeholder decisions where HR, Finance, and Operations may all have a say
  • Manage sales cycles ranging from 2 weeks (SMB, HR product) to 3 months (enterprise, audit tool) simultaneously
  • Close deals, coordinate onboarding handover to the delivery team, and maintain the relationship through the initial implementation period

5. Pipeline Management & Reporting

  • Maintain a live, accurate pipeline in CRM across all three products at all times
  • Report weekly to the founder on: leads generated, demos scheduled, proposals sent, deals closed, and blockers
  • Identify patterns - which products are gaining traction, which industries are responding, which buyer personas are hardest to reach - and share insights with the team
  • Set and track personal monthly targets for outreach volume, demo count, and revenue closure.

Job Description
Title: International AI Research Fellowship
Industry: IT Services
Duration: 20 hours per month | Paid | 12 weeks
Net Solutions is looking for curious, analytical university students to join a small international research program exploring how AI is changing technology, commerce, marketing, and business. This is not a conventional internship. Fellows will work on real research questions that matter to Net Solutions and its clients. You will be given a defined problem to investigate, access to our team and relevant materials, and considerable freedom in how you approach it. We expect you to use AI extensively. We also expect you to question it.


Responsibilities
  • Projects will vary, but examples could include:
  • How companies in your market are adopting AI
  • How AI is changing ecommerce and digital buying
  • How businesses are preparing their content and product data for AI-driven discovery
  • How leading companies are positioning new AI products and services
  • How buyers are finding and evaluating technology partners
  • Emerging AI tools, platforms, and business models
  • Competitor and market landscapes
  • Research into specific industries, companies, or technologies
  • How AI-generated answers differ across markets
  • New opportunities created by agentic AI and AI-driven commerce
  • These are examples rather than a fixed curriculum. Each Fellow will receive a defined research brief.


Key Requirements
  • Depending on your project, you may:
  • Find and evaluate primary and secondary sources
  • Interview or speak with relevant people where appropriate
  • Analyze companies, competitors, and market developments
  • Use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other AI tools as research partners
  • Verify AI-generated claims rather than accepting them at face value
  • Identify patterns and insights in the information you collect
  • Produce concise written research
  • Present your findings and recommendations to the Net Solutions team


Nice to have
  • Currently studying at a university
  • Intellectually curious
  • A strong researcher
  • Comfortable writing in English
  • Able to distinguish evidence from assertion
  • Comfortable using modern AI tools
  • Willing to challenge AI output
  • Interested in technology, business, AI, or digital commerce
  • Able to work independently
  • Good at turning a large amount of information into a clear point of view
  • Students studying business, economics, computer science, engineering, design, marketing, journalism, social sciences, and other disciplines are welcome.
  • TIME COMMITMENT
  • The Fellowship runs for 12 weeks.
  • Expected commitment is approximately 20 hours per month, or roughly 45 hours per week.
  • There are no daily working hours. The program is designed to fit alongside university.
  • Most work will be asynchronous, with periodic online meetings with the Net Solutions team.
  • LOCATION
  • The Fellowship is remote and open to university students based in:
  • United States
  • Canada
  • United Kingdom
  • Australia
  • South Africa
  • Applicants should normally be studying and living in the market for which they apply.
  • COMPENSATION
  • This is a paid program. The expected monthly fellowship award is:
  • United States: US$500 per month
  • Canada: C$600 per month
  • United Kingdom: 350 per month
  • Australia: A$600 per month
  • South Africa: R5,000 per month
  • The award reflects the expected 20-hour monthly commitment and participation in the 12-week Fellowship.
  • HOW WE THINK ABOUT AI
  • We are not looking for people who simply know how to prompt ChatGPT.
  • We are looking for people who know when not to believe it.
  • Use AI to explore, challenge, organize, and accelerate your thinking. But the evidence, judgment, and conclusions in your work remain yours.


Collaboration
  • SELECTION PROCESS
  • 1. Application
  • Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile and tell us briefly about something you have researched, built, written, or investigated because you were genuinely curious about it.
  • 2. Short research challenge
  • Shortlisted applicants will receive a small research problem. You may use any tools, including AI.
  • We will assess the quality of your thinking, sources, and conclusions rather than how polished the document looks.
  • 3. Conversation
  • Finalists will have a short conversation with the Net Solutions team about their research, how they approached it, and what they learned.
  • The strongest Fellows may be invited to work with Net Solutions on future research or other opportunities.

Job Description
Title: AI Marketing Research Associate
Experience: Fresher/Entry Level
Industry: IT Services
Duration: Paid | 12-week program | Part-time
Net Solutions is looking for an unusually sharp university student or recent graduate in the UK to work with our marketing team on research, content, AI-assisted workflows, and marketing operations. This is not a conventional marketing internship. We are looking for someone who can take an unfamiliar business question, research it properly, use AI intelligently, challenge what the AI produces, and turn the work into something useful. You do not need years of marketing experience. You do need to be a strong thinker, researcher, and communicator.


Responsibilities
  • Researching industries, companies, competitors, and market trends
  • Reviewing AI-generated articles and marketing copy for logic, accuracy, and weak arguments
  • Finding and verifying credible primary sources for claims and statistics
  • Researching prospects and target accounts for campaigns and events
  • Comparing competitor positioning, services, and go-to-market approaches
  • Supporting SEO and AI-search research
  • Helping turn research into useful content, campaign, and sales material
  • Testing ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other AI tools against real marketing tasks
  • Developing repeatable AI-assisted processes that make our marketing team faster
  • Bringing a UK-market perspective to messaging, research, and campaigns
  • You will work on live Net Solutions initiatives rather than simulated internship projects.


Nice to have
  • Excellent written English
  • Strong research and analytical ability
  • An instinct for questioning information rather than simply accepting it
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • The ability to understand unfamiliar subjects quickly
  • Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini
  • The ability to distinguish credible evidence from something that merely looks credible
  • Good judgment about what makes writing clear, useful, and believable
  • Curiosity about technology, AI, business, and marketing
  • The ability to work independently once the objective is clear
  • A marketing or technical degree is not required.
  • HOW WE THINK ABOUT AI
  • We expect you to use AI extensively.
  • We also expect you to recognize when it is wrong, generic, poorly reasoned, or unsupported.
  • If your approach is simply to ask ChatGPT to produce an answer and submit it, this role will not be a good fit.
  • The ability to challenge AI output matters more to us than knowing clever prompts.
  • WORKING ARRANGEMENT
  • This is a 12-week, part-time paid position, requiring approximately 1520 hours per week.
  • The role is UK-based and remote, and will involve working with members of the Net Solutions team in India. Some availability during UK mornings will therefore be important.
  • Hours can be arranged around university commitments.
  • COMPENSATION
  • 1620 per hour, depending on demonstrated ability and experience.


Collaboration
  • SELECTION PROCESS
  • 1. Application
  • Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile and, if possible, something that demonstrates how you think, research, or write.
  • 2. Paid practical assignment
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a short exercise involving research, AI-generated content, fact checking, and judgment.
  • You may use any AI tools you want.
  • We are interested in both what you produce and how you got there.
  • 3. Conversation
  • A short discussion about your assignment, how you approached it, what you disagreed with, and what you would do differently.
  • Exceptional performers may be considered for future opportunities with Net Solutions.

descriptionFromApi:
The Opportunity

Join us as an AI Demo Engineer, a truly ground-floor role where you ll be instrumental in shaping the future of Scout, our brand-new AI product. You ll tackle the exciting challenge of building, not just maintaining, dynamic AI-powered demonstrations that empower our Sales Engineers and directly drive deal closures. This is your chance to build a critical function from scratch, defining processes and making a tangible impact on our market approach, bringing real variety and ownership to every project.

What Youll Do

As our first AI Demo Engineer in Bangalore, you will occupy a unique, pivotal position, bridging the gap between traditional Demo Engineering and AI engineering. Your primary focus will be on constructing sophisticated agentic Scout workflows, moving beyond static demo data to craft intelligent, multi-step solutions. You will own the creation of a comprehensive library of reusable standard demo agents, complete with robust data and documentation, serving as the essential foundation for all sales demonstrations. Furthermore, you will design and implement prospect-specific agents tailored to individual deal requirements, directly contributing to successful sales outcomes. A crucial part of your role involves maintaining the main demo template, ensuring it remains current, functional after platform updates, and populated with fresh data and golden records. Beyond building, you will become a diagnostic expert, analyzing prospect usage within Proof-of-Concept (POC) instances, identifying why a solution might not be landing, and expertly tuning agents, data, and configurations to optimize outcomes and secure conversions. You wont inherit a fixed process; instead, youll help define the operating model for this critical new team function.

The Skills Youll Have

Agentic AI / Scout Configuration

  • Youll build or configure at least one agentic AI workflow, demonstrating proficiency with agents that plan, call tools, and complete multi-step tasks.

  • Youll possess hands-on prompt engineering experience, having written and iterated prompts/instructions for LLM-based tools.

  • Youll have a basic understanding of MCP (Multi-Cloud Platform) or comparable tool-calling/connector patterns.

  • Youll have designed multi-system agentic workflows end-to-end, showcasing your ability to move beyond single-agent/single-tool solutions.

  • Youll have built or worked directly with MCP connectors, leveraging your deep technical expertise.

Business Translation & Demo Enablement

  • Youll translate complex business requirements into working demos, prototypes, or configurations without extensive guidance.

  • Youll quickly understand a prospects business process, translating it into value-led Scout workflows and compelling demo scripts.

  • Youll scope realistic deliverables and deadlines in collaboration with Sales Engineers, proactively closing gaps in incomplete requirements.

  • Competitive salary.

  • Excellent English reading comprehension and written communication skills.
  • Strong computer literacy and comfort with annotation tools.

  • High attention to detail and analytical thinking

  • Willingness to step beyond assigned tasks when needed
  • Accountability, ownership, and adaptability

  • Client-specific strategic roles

This role supports:

  • Improved delivery timelines
  • Operational scalability
  • Client satisfaction and revenue growth

  • Exposure to innovative healthcare and AI companies

  • Configure monitoring, logging, and alerting.

  • Support audit and compliance activities.

  • Measure accuracy and business performance.
  • Execute AI evaluation frameworks.
  • Document known limitations and mitigation actions.
  • Documentation & Knowledge Management: Maintain technical documentation.
  • Create architecture diagrams and deployment guides.
  • Produce support documentation and training materials.
  • Ensure solutions can be maintained independently of individual developers.

  • Analyze usage patterns and user feedback.
  • Recommend enhancements that improve business outcomes.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelors / master's in engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.

  • Power Platform, Azure Functions and Logic Apps: create low-code automations, serverless components and integrations across Microsoft 365, APIs and enterprise systems.
  • Software Engineering, DevOps & Operations: Python, REST APIs and JSON: develop AI services, integration utilities, automation components and structured data interfaces for enterprise systems.
  • GitHub, CI/CD and software design patterns: manage version control, code reviews, automated deployments and reusable architectures for maintainable AI products.
  • Azure Cloud, infrastructure as code and observability: deploy, monitor and operate AI workloads using secure, repeatable and auditable cloud environments.

Behavioral Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions

descriptionFromApi:
Job Summary

Communications and External Relations (CER) is to help deliver financial and political support for the World Bank Group, strengthen the Bank Group s role as a global thought leader in development by enhancing and safeguarding its reputation, and supporting operational teams to achieve country outcomes. CER manages corporate communications and global engagement with key stakeholders, including media, civil society, foundations, private sector, donor countries, and international organizations, as well as employee engagement. CER also manages strategic communications for the World Bank Group s Regions and technical units and leads the management of reputation risk.

Regional Stakeholder Engagement in CER (CERRS) manages strategic communications across the seven regions of the World Bank Group driving engagement across regions and country offices to align local efforts with our global strategy.

The work aims to build support and understanding for World Bank Group (WBG) priorities across a range of stakeholders; enhance and protect the reputation of the WBG as a leading development organization; support operational effectiveness and social accountability by sharing development progress, knowledge, and results.

Recognizing that economic and social contexts evolve rapidly, and that communications technologies have revolutionized the ways that information travels, we are building a team of dynamic and innovative professionals prepared to use innovative engagement strategies, traditional and digital tools, including social media and artificial intelligence to shape the debate on development priorities and tradeoffs.

is among the world s fastest-growing, most dynamic regions. The World Bank partners with countries across EAP to promote economic growth and job creation, strengthen human capital, and advance sustainable energy, water, and agriculture for a resilient and prosperous future for all. Over the past two decades, EAP has sustained strong growth, lifting hundreds of millions of people out of poverty and transforming economies and lives. Many countries have reached upper-middle-income status and are aiming for high-income status. Poverty rates continue to fall, with 24 million people in the region projected to escape poverty between 2024 and 2025 (based on the upper-middle-income poverty line).

Despite this progress, major challenges remain. About 320 million people will reach working age over the next decade, while only around 110 million new jobs are projected-making job creation an urgent priority. Widening inequality within and across countries underscores the need to expand access to education, healthcare, and social safety nets, particularly for the urban poor and rural communities. Rapid urbanization increases demand for transport connectivity, water and sanitation, and pollution management. Meeting rising electricity needs at affordable cost-without sharply increasing greenhouse gas emissions-requires accelerating the energy transition. Adaptation and resilience to extreme weather and natural disasters are critical in a region that includes 13 of the world s 30 most climate-vulnerable countries. Since 2000, EAP has experienced 70 percent of the world s natural disasters, affecting more than 1.6 billion people.

East Asia and Pacific Regional Stakeholder Engagement Team (CEREA)

The East Asia and Pacific (EAP) Regional Stakeholder Engagement team (CEREA) manages strategic communications and external relations in support of the WBG strategic priorities in EAP. It includes communications and external relations professionals both in Washington, D.C. and WBG EAP Country Offices.

CEREA s goal is to connect and engage with diverse stakeholders across EAP to communicate about the WBG mission to create a world free of poverty on a livable planet, promote an informed, evidence-based debate about development in the region, and enhance the WBG s reputation as an effective development partner for the countries of East Asia and Pacific. CEREA s key audiences include government officials, think tanks and researchers, business leaders and associations, investors, development partners, civil society organizations, and journalists.

Senior Communications and External Affairs Officer

The Senior External Affairs Officer is a senior member of the EAP (CEREA) Regional Stakeholder Engagement team and serves as a strategic advisor to regional management on stakeholder engagement, communications, advocacy, and reputational risk management.

The position plays a key role in advancing the World Bank Groups regional stakeholder engagement agenda and driving delivery across CERs four business lines: Stakeholder Engagement, Strategic Business Marketing, Advocacy & Campaigns, and Risk & Issue Management. The role requires strong strategic judgment, political awareness, and the ability to anticipate risks, influence stakeholders, shape narratives, and mobilize support for development priorities.

Working closely with regional and country management, operational teams, and colleagues across IBRD, IDA, IFC, and MIGA, the Senior Communications and External Affairs Officer helps advance a coordinated One World Bank Group approach to external affairs. The position combines strategic advisory responsibilities with hands-on delivery and is expected to lead complex assignments, support priority initiatives, and contribute directly to execution across the regional portfolio.

The Senior Communications & External Relations Officer position is based in Washington, D.C. and reports to CER Manager, EAP.

Key Responsibilities

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Lead stakeholder engagement strategies that advance World Bank Group priorities, support country outcomes, and strengthen the institutions influence across the region.
  • Build and maintain relationships with key stakehholders, including government officials, development partners, private sector leaders, civil society organizations, media, academia, and other influential actors.
  • Lead stakeholder intelligence efforts, including stakeholder mapping, analysis, and monitoring of actors, coalitions, and trends that may affect World Bank Group priorities, reform efforts, or reputation.
  • Advise management and operational teams on stakeholder dynamics, political economy considerations, coalition-building opportunities, and engagement approaches.
  • Ensure stakeholder insights and external perspectives are incorporated into communications strategies, advocacy efforts, risk management, and operational decision-making.

Strategic Business Marketing

  • Position the World Bank Group as a trusted development partner by articulating the value of integrated public-private solutions and the One World Bank Group approach.
  • Develop strategic narratives, engagement approaches, and communications products that support regional priorities, operational objectives, and client engagement.
  • Identify and elevate flagship operations, reform milestones, knowledge products, and success stories that demonstrate impact and generate demand for World Bank Group engagement.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen visibility and understanding of the World Bank Groups work among governments, investors, private sector partners, foundations, and development stakeholders.

Advocacy & Campaigns

  • Lead advocacy and communications campaigns that support development priorities, reform efforts, and institutional objectives.
  • Develop compelling messaging and narratives that translate complex development issues into clear, accessible, and persuasive communications.
  • Coordinate regional contributions to corporate and global campaigns, adapting messages and approaches to regional and country contexts.
  • Oversee the development of speeches, op-eds, press releases, talking points, digital content, and other communications products for senior management and key stakeholders.
  • Help ensure consistent, targeted, and effective messaging across communications, stakeholder engagement, digital, and media channels.

Risk & Issue Management

  • Serve as a senior advisor on reputational risk and issue management, helping management anticipate, assess, and respond to developments that could affect World Bank Group operations, stakeholder relationships, or reputation.

Orgzit is a SaaS software product business. We help small and mid-sized businesses implement systems in their sales, operations, and accounting functions with CRM & workflow automation software solutions.


Our unique value proposition is our no-code technology advantage, which enables us to offer customised business software solutions that are the easiest to use and implement in the shortest time.

We are a member of two accelerators: Upekkha, the #1 accelerator for SaaS businesses in India, and Nasscom Startups. We are a profitable business and are investing in growing 100% every year for the next five years.

Our team member Karan Asthana says, “Orgzit has a very open, transparent, and friendly culture. You get to work closely with visionary founders and build a world-class business. It is the best place for someone who wants to learn and become a master of their domain.”

Visit our website at https://orgzit.com to learn more about us.

We're looking for a highly organised, trustworthy Executive Assistant who can manage accounts, HR, recruitment, and founder support with equal ease. The ideal Executive Assistant is proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable juggling multiple workstreams without dropping the ball. Above all, they should be someone who takes ownership, learns fast, and wants to grow with a young, fast-moving startup.


Key Responsibilities


  • Accounts & Finance: Own end-to-end accounting operations: invoicing, expense tracking, monthly GST/TDS filings and payments, P&L dashboard reporting.
  • HR & People Operations: Be the single point of contact for all team member matters: onboarding/offboarding, leave records, payroll inputs, and appraisals. Run the monthly performance review cycle (inputs ratings 1-1s) and drive team connection through weekly check-ins and quarterly team events.
  • Recruitment: Run recruitment drives start to finish: draft JDs, post on job portals, schedule webinars and interviews.
  • Founder & Admin Support: Manage the founder's calendar, inbox, and notes. Set up meetings with customers and manage team access to software tools and applications.

Skills Required


  • Communication: Clear, precise, and confident in both written and verbal communication.
  • Organisation & Attention to Detail: Manages multiple workstreams (accounts, HR, recruitment, admin) without missing tasks.
  • Proactive Ownership: Anticipates needs before being asked and takes initiative to close gaps.
  • Reliability: Dependable and consistent.
  • Discretion & Integrity: Trusted with confidential information, including founder communications, compensation data, and team matters, and handles it with judgment and professionalism..
  • Coordination & Follow-through: Keeps multiple people (team members, candidates, vendors, freelancers) moving toward deadlines without needing constant reminders.
  • Tool Fluency: Comfortable working across Google Sheets, Google Docs, Slack, etc. to move fast and reduce manual effort.
  • AI Tool Proficiency: Skilled at using AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude for research, drafting documents, and writing messages.
  • Ability to learn quickly and apply feedback in real time.

Work Location


  • This position is a work-from-office role.
  • Office location: Sector 44, Gurgaon (near Millennium City Centre metro station)

Work Days and Timings


  • Days: Monday to Friday + alternate Saturdays
  • Timings: 10am to 7pm

Compensation


  • Full-time CTC: Rs. 3,60,00 to 4,20,000 per annum

Experience

  • 1+ years of experience.

Benefits


  • Medical insurance
  • Leave encashment
  • Relocation assistance

Why Join Us


As a small, bootstrapped, fast-growing startup, we strive to provide a supportive and rewarding work environment that values our team members’ contributions. We provide an unparalleled environment to professionals looking to grow in their careers:

  • Growth Opportunities: Take on new responsibilities, learn, and grow personally and professionally
  • Ownership and Impact: Make a significant impact on our company's direction and growth
  • Collaborative Environment: Foster teamwork, open communication, and mutual respect
  • Rapid Learning: Wear multiple hats, develop diverse skills, and gain valuable experience
  • Recognition and Appreciation: Your contributions are recognised and celebrated
  • Transparent Communication: Stay informed with open updates about company progress and opportunities.

Please note: This role is intended as a growth path: we're looking for someone who is eager to learn the operational and financial backbone of a growing SaaS business from the ground up. Strong performance during the internship will lead directly to a full-time role and growing responsibility over time.

title: AI & Data Platform Engineer
jobDescription:
AI & Data Platform Engineer


Role Summary : We are looking for an AI & Data Platform Engineer to design, develop, and support enterprise data and analytics solutions while helping drive the adoption of AI across the organization. The role will primarily focus on Microsoft Fabric-based data engineering and analytics, while also exploring and building AI-powered solutions using Azure AI Foundry and related Microsoft AI services.


The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in data engineering and analytics, combined with a curiosity for emerging AI technologies and the ability to rapidly experiment, prototype, and deliver business-focused AI solutions.


This role is expected to evolve alongside Microsoft's AI ecosystem, requiring continuous learning, experimentation, and the ability to translate emerging technologies into practical business solutions.


Key Responsibilities :


• Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines, Lakehouses, Warehouses, Semantic Models, and Power BI solutions using Microsoft Fabric.

• Build and optimize scalable data models and analytics solutions to support business reporting and decision-making.

• Work with structured and unstructured enterprise data from multiple business systems.

• Develop data transformation workflows using SQL, Python, Spark, and Fabric notebooks.

• Explore, prototype, and implement AI solutions using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and related Microsoft AI services.

• Build AI agents and copilots that leverage enterprise data to improve business productivity and decision-making.

• Collaborate with business and technology teams to identify opportunities for automation and AI-driven innovation.

• Follow best practices for data governance, security, version control, testing, and documentation.


Required Skills :


• Strong experience with Microsoft Fabric and Power BI. • Proficiency in SQL and Python.

• Experience with data modelling, ETL/ELT, and data engineering concepts.

• Good understanding of APIs and system integrations. • Familiarity with Git and modern development practices. Preferred Skills

• Exposure to Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, or Generative AI technologies.

• Experience building AI agents, copilots, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions.

• Knowledge of vector search, prompt engineering, and LLM application development.

• Experience working with Microsoft Azure services and enterprise platforms.


What We Are Looking For :


• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. • A passion for learning emerging AI technologies.

• Ability to independently research, prototype, and implement new capabilities.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder collaboration skills.

• A continuous improvement mindset with a focus on delivering business value.

jobDescription:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we ve raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprintos extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Life as a Sprinter -

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we dont wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams arent built by sitting together, theyre built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

The mission -
We are seeking a Senior Account Executive (Enterprise) to drive growth by owning the full sales cycle - from prospecting and pipeline creation to closing high-value, multi-stakeholder deals. This is a role for a proven hunter and closer who thrives in competitive environments, engages C-level executives with confidence, and consistently delivers results. You ll be selling a category-defining solution, working with ambitious mid-market and growth-stage companies, and playing a key role in shaping our revenue engine.
Where youll leave your mark
  • Own and manage the end-to-end sales process for Enterprise accounts with an ACV of $50k to $250k
  • Prospect, qualify, and build a strong pipeline of new logos while expanding within existing customers.
  • Lead consultative, value-driven sales conversations with VP and C-level executives.
  • Build and execute territory plans to systematically open new opportunities.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with SDRs, Solutions Consultants, and Marketing to accelerate pipeline.
  • Accurately forecast and manage deals through disciplined pipeline management.
  • Consistently meet or exceed sales quotas and performance targets.
The kind of builder were looking for -
  • 8+ Yrs is B2B Sales experience / Account Executiveroles withinSaaS, Software, or Technology Services, with a strong focus on new logo acquisition.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in outbound prospecting and pipeline generation.
  • 4+ years of experience selling the within the region, including territory planning and regional sales ownership.
  • Working knowledge of structured sales methodologies such as MEDDICC/MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, or Consultative Selling.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding annual new business quotas , with consistent high performance.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, discovery, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage CXO-level stakeholders and close complex deals.
How we care for our Sprinters
  • Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach.
  • Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance.
  • We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills.
  • We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to.
  • Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary.
  • Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you.

Inclusion Diversity -

At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed-not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.

Were proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. descriptionFromApi:
Job Summary

Were looking for a Principal AI Automation Test Engineer to define and drive the automation and AI-testing strategy across multiple products and teams. Youll own the technical direction of our quality engineering practice - architecting frameworks, setting standards, mentoring engineers, and pioneering the adoption of AI/ML-driven testing at scale. This is a hands-on leadership role: you still write and review code, but your impact is measured in the reliability, velocity, and maturity of automation across the org.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and own end-to-end automation frameworks in JavaScript/TypeScript (Playwright, Cypress, WebdriverIO, Cucumber/BDD) and Java (Selenium WebDriver, TestNG/JUnit), and set the patterns other teams build on.
  • Define the org-wide automation strategy - test pyramid, coverage targets, tooling standards, and the build-vs-buy decisions for testing platforms.
  • Lead API automation (REST/GraphQL) architecture across JS and Java tooling (Supertest/Postman, RestAssured), including contract testing and service virtualization.
  • Champion AI/ML-powered testing - self-healing locators, visual regression, and intelligent/risk-based test selection - running evaluations and driving adoption decisions across teams.
  • Integrate LLMs and AI coding assistants (Copilot, Claude, Cursor, custom GPT/agent workflows) into the engineering lifecycle, and establish where they add value vs. where they introduce risk - codified as team guidance.
  • Design test strategies for AI/LLM-powered product features - handling non-determinism, building eval-style and guardrail assertions, and defining quality bars for generative features.
  • Own CI/CD test pipeline architecture (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Bitbucket Pipelines, Azure DevOps) and containerized/parallel execution (Docker, and orchestration at scale).
  • Establish flaky-test governance - root-cause practices, quarantine policies, and reliability metrics that keep suites trustworthy across the org.
  • Mentor and level up automation engineers; run design reviews, set code-quality standards (POM, centralized locators, data-driven design), and grow the teams AI-testing capability.
  • Partner with engineering leadership and product to shift quality left and embed testing into the SDLC as a first-class concern.

title: Full-Stack Developer (Backend-Focused) - Python Stack
jobDescription:
Experience with relational database design and migrations. .

Experience consuming third-party APIs (payment processors,webhooks,integrations). . Redis or caching layer optimisation. . GitHub Actions or similar CI / CD pipeline experience. .

Prior experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI,Anthropic,etc.)
descriptionFromApi:
Youre building systems that power AI workflows - REST APIs that handle concurrent requests, databases that dont lose data, deployments that dont wake you up at 3 AM. You understand that backend isnt just about making things work; its about making them work reliably.

You wont be writing microservices in a vacuum. Your APIs feed mobile apps, web interfaces, and integrations. Your database decisions matter. Your deployments get reviewed. Your code runs in production, and youre the one who fixes it when it breaks.

Frontend work exists, but youre being hired because the backend is the constraint. Frontend will evolve. The API is permanent.

What You Will Do
  • Design and build REST APIs using Python, Django, and Django REST Framework.
  • Write efficient SQL queries, optimise indexes, and manage relational databases under load.
  • Implement secure authentication, authorisation, and role-based access control.
  • Deploy backend services using Docker and containerised workflows.
  • Build CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment.
  • Debug production issues and ship fixes with minimal ceremony.
  • Collaborate closely with frontend teams on API contracts and data flow.
  • Write clean, testable code and participate in code reviews.
  • Participate in sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives.
What We Are Looking For
  • 1+ years of production experience with Python and Django - non-negotiable.
  • Demonstrable experience building and shipping REST APIs with Django REST Framework.
  • Strong SQL fundamentals: write efficient queries, understand indexes, optimise slow queries.
  • Direct experience deploying production code and debugging issues in production.
  • Git workflow and ability to write clean, reviewable code.
  • Understanding of authentication, authorisation, and basic security patterns.
Good to Have
  • PostgreSQL experience (we use Postgres, not MySQL).
  • Docker containerisation for local development or deployment.
  • Basic AWS knowledge (EC2, RDS, or similar).
  • Experience with relational database design and migrations.
  • Familiarity with asynchronous task queues (Celery or similar).
  • Previous work on multi-user or multi-tenant systems.
  • Experience consuming third-party APIs (payment processors, webhooks, integrations).
  • Redis or caching layer optimisation.
  • GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD pipeline experience.
  • Prior experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.).
What You Will Work On
  • Python (3.8+) with Django and Django REST Framework.
  • PostgreSQL as the primary database, Redis for caching and task queues.
  • React.js on the frontend - you own the API contract, not the UI.
  • AWS infrastructure: EC2, ECS, RDS.
  • Docker for containerised deployments, GitHub Actions for CI/CD.
  • Celery for background job processing.
Why Kuvaka
  • Your code runs in production, not in staging. The APIs you build power healthcare applications, manufacturing workflows, and enterprise platforms - real users, real uptime requirements, real stakes.
  • You work with senior engineers who care about architecture and code quality. You get exposure to AI integration, cloud infrastructure, and working across multiple verticals in one role.
  • Growth is tied to shipping, not time served.

descriptionFromApi:
We Are Synopsys
is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their RD capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
You Are
You have spent a decade building, verifying, or supporting silicon that ships, and you know the difference between a clean integration and one that costs your customer three months of debug. You understand that a protocol spec is just the starting point. The real work begins when someone tries to configure PCIe Gen5 in a power-constrained automotive SoC or bring up DDR5 on a board that was not quite laid out the way the datasheet suggested.
You have been in the room when things go wrong during tape-out or bring-up, and you are the person who stays calm, asks the right questions, and finds the path through. You can read Verilog, trace a timing violation back to its root cause, and explain what went wrong to a customer engineer who is three time zones away and under pressure. You do not need perfect documentation to move forward. You work with what you have, fill in the gaps, and keep the project on track.
At Synopsys, you will work directly with customers integrating our Interface IP into their most critical designs. The problems are real, the stakes are high, and the work you do will directly determine whether their silicon works on the first pass.
What You'll Be Doing
  • Serve as the technical point of contact for customers integrating Synopsys Interface IP, including Ethernet, PCIe, and DDR, into complex SoC designs
  • Guide customers through IP configuration, feature selection, and integration into their RTL and verification environments
  • Debug critical issues across simulation, synthesis, static timing analysis, and physical design flows using tools like VCS, Design Compiler, and PrimeTime
  • Support silicon and system bring-up activities, working with customers to diagnose and resolve hardware-level issues in lab environments
  • Collaborate with Synopsys RD, product engineering, and field teams to deliver tailored solutions and escalate complex technical problems
  • Stay current with evolving protocol specifications for Ethernet, PCIe, DDR, and emerging standards relevant to automotive, AI, and data center applications
  • Travel occasionally to customer sites for on-site integration support, training, and bring-up assistance
The Impact You Will Have
  • Enable successful first-pass silicon for customers by catching integration issues early and providing expert guidance through tape-out
  • Reduce customer time-to-market by resolving technical blockers quickly and accurately during critical project phases
  • Strengthen customer relationships and drive repeat business by becoming a trusted technical advisor they rely on for complex integrations
  • Influence future IP product roadmaps by feeding real-world customer requirements and pain points back to Synopsys RD teams
  • Expand adoption of Synopsys Interface IP across high-growth markets including automotive, AI accelerators, and hyperscale data centers
  • Contribute to the success of next-generation products that depend on high-speed, low-latency connectivity in increasingly complex system architectures
  • Build internal knowledge and best practices that improve how Synopsys supports customers across the entire applications engineering organization
What You'll Need
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field with focus on VLSI or digital design
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in ASIC/SoC design, verification, or applications engineering with exposure to full tape-out cycles
  • Deep working knowledge of at least one high-speed protocol: Ethernet (10G/25G/50G/100G/400G), PCIe (Gen3/Gen4/Gen5), or DDR (DDR4/DDR5/LPDDR5)
  • Strong RTL coding skills in Verilog or VHDL, with ability to read, debug, and modify customer design code
  • Practical experience with simulation (VCS, ModelSim, Xcelium), synthesis (Design Compiler, Genus), and static timing analysis (PrimeTime, Tempus) in a UNIX/Linux environment
  • Familiarity with clock domain crossing (CDC), reset domain crossing (RDC), lint, DFT, and logical equivalence checking (LEC) is a strong plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences
Who You Are
  • You can take a vague customer problem description, ask three clarifying questions, and walk away with a clear action plan that actually solves the issue
  • You are comfortable working across time zones and cultures, adapting your communication style to meet customers where they are technically and operationally
  • You manage multiple customer engagements at once without dropping threads, keeping stakeholders informed and issues moving toward resolution
  • You know when to dig in and solve a problem yourself and when to pull in specialists from RD, and you do both without ego
  • You are willing to travel occasionally for customer visits, training sessions, and on-site bring-up support when the situation calls for it
  • You stay current with industry trends and protocol evolution because you understand that what you learned five years ago is not enough for what customers are building today
The Team You'll Be Part Of
Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.

Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
